takes.text:
<Subject 1> = a severe designer, in an all-black smock and tinted glasses

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, documentary interview footage. A medium close-up of <Subject 1> (S1) seated in a white-walled atelier crowded with half-finished garments on dress forms. The camera holds a static shot. <Subject 1> (S1) says in a quiet, precise voice: <d>[English] We are post-shoulder now.</d> [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the hands of <Subject 1> (S1) smoothing a length of moss velvet across a cutting table. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. <Subject 1> (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Beige is not a colour. It is a decision.</d> while their lips remain completely closed.

overall_soundscape: A sewing machine rattles somewhere in the back and muffled street noise drifts in. Scissors cut slowly through heavy fabric.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse, detuned piano figure at a slow tempo.
picks: Beige is not a colour. It is a decision.
